margin_definition: min over all 8 greedy steps of fp32(top1_logit - top2_logit)
selection_rule: sort eligible positive matched-reference top-1 margins by (margin,case_id); select four smallest and four largest; finite zero/nonpositive margins are ineligible, not fatal; a non-finite reference margin (NaN/+Inf/-Inf) is an unconditional reference correctness failure (NONFINITE_REFERENCE_MARGIN) and stops selection
